description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain call filters (interceptors) and their behavior in various scenarios such as request/response manipulation, filter order, exception handling, extension method interception, generics, and integration with streaming. It also includes configuration of test clusters, filters, and dependency injection illustrating complex testing of filter pipelines.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterTests
classes.description: Test suite for verifying Orleans grain call filters, execution order, request/response manipulation, stream handling, exception processing, dependency injection, filter behavior with generic and extension methods, and complex inheritance scenarios.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Sets up the Orleans test cluster with specific configuration, including system-wide and grain-specific filters, memory streams, grain storage, and dependency injection setup for integration testing.

classes.name: SiloInvokerTestSiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the silo builder to include extension methods, system-wide filters, stream providers, and storage options.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the client builder with incoming/outgoing filters, stream providers, and retry logic for testing client-side filter behaviors.

classes.name: GrainCallFilterWithDependencies
classes.description: An implementation of an incoming grain call filter demonstrating dependency injection, modifying request context as part of filter chain.

methods.name: RetryCertainCalls
methods.description: An outgoing filter method implementing retry logic on specific grain method calls by catching exceptions and retrying with modified arguments.
